remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 1-full-bath two-story home, tucked away on a quiet street in Niagara Falls and conveniently located close to shopping, dining, and all the amenities you need! Offering a comfortable and functional layout, this home is full of warmth and opportunity. The main level features a spacious, open living room and dining room, creating an inviting flow for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen offers plenty of cabinet and counter space, with a window overlooking the expansive, fully fenced backyard, a wonderful space for outdoor entertaining, relaxing, gardening, or letting the dogs run and play. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms and a full bath. The full basement provides loads of storage space and endless potential for additional living, recreation, hobby, or workspace. Outside, the large fully fenced yard is a standout feature, while the concrete driveway provides convenient off-street parking and room for a garage. A solid home in a quiet neighborhood setting, offering a great layout, generous outdoor space, and plenty of potential to make it your own. Come see the possibilities!
